item.title: Energy Secretary: Trump was "aware of the risks to energy flows" before Iran war
item.description: Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that President Trump was "well aware of the risks to energy flows" before launching the war in Iran earlier this year, but argued "the world cannot sustain a nuclear-armed Iran."

item.title: Samuel Alito says that political attacks aimed at Supreme Court can be "quite damaging"
item.description: As the Supreme Court is set to start its new term, Supreme Court justice Samuel Alito sat down with CBS News' Jan Crawford in a rare interview ahead of the release of his new book, saying that political attacks aimed at the high court -- most recently by President Trump on his social media platform -- "can be quite damaging."

item.title: Zach Lahn, Iowa's GOP governor candidate, says the state's farmers "really have a problem"
item.description: Zach Lahn, the Republican candidate for governor in Iowa, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that he believes the state's "farmers understand that for a long time they have been treated as price takers, and really the deck has been stacked against them. And now when you add in the higher cost of diesel, we really have a problem."

item.description: Missed the second half of the show? CBS News correspondent Matt Gutman reports, Iowa GOP nominee for governor Zach Lahn and top Biden Middle East adviser Brett McGurk join.

item.title: Biden adviser Brett McGurk recalls "pretty draconian measures" being considered against Israel
item.description: Brett McGurk, who served as a top adviser to President Biden on the Middle East, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" about the high-stakes negotiations between Israel and Hamas, and how the Biden administration was considering "pretty draconian measures against Israel" in April 2024.

item.title: CBS News Battleground Tracker poll finds Democrats maintain House advantage
item.description: A new CBS News Battleground Tracker poll finds that if the midterm elections were held today, Democrats would hold a 229-206 advantage over Republicans in the U.S. House, giving Democrats the majority. CBS News director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto digs into the new CBS News poll.

item.title: Energy Secretary says Trump was "aware of the risks to energy flows" before launching Iran war
item.description: Energy Secretary Chris Wright told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that President Trump was "well aware of the risks to energy flows" before launching the Iran war, but he said the president said "I simply cannot. The world cannot sustain a nuclear-armed Iran, and I'm not going to do it."

item.description: Debris has been found of a medical jet with six people on board that went missing near Nantucket while flying from Bermuda to Boston early Saturday.

item.description: In a CBS News interview, Biden-era Middle East adviser Brett McGurk recounted the administration's response to the Oct. 7 attack, its handling of the Israel-Hamas war, the role of Iran and the long-sought push to normalize relations between Israel and Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Sen. Mark Kelly says he's seen "a lot of energy" among Democratic voters
item.description: Democratic Sen. Mark Kelly, who has been campaigning for others in his party this election, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that he's seen "a lot of energy" among voters. "People are frustrated and they're fed up with Washington D.C. right now, and they know that this president is not addressing, you know, any of the needs that affect them and their families," Kelly said.
